FIELDS.NAME: Crystal Clean Laundry Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Crystal Clean Laundry Services, we provide top-quality dry cleaning and laundry services for both residential and commercial clients. Our operations focus on the meticulous care of garments, utilizing advanced cleaning techniques and environmentally friendly solvents to ensure the best results. We do not handle hazardous or medical textiles to maintain a safe and compliant operation. Our team of skilled technicians adheres to strict safety protocols and is dedicated to exceptional customer service, ensuring that each item is treated with the utmost care. We maintain rigorous equipment servicing practices, with all machinery checked annually by certified professionals, and keep detailed maintenance records readily available for inspection. Our commitment to compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations underscores our dedication to environmental responsibility and operational safety.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities or conditions mentioned in the application and confirms that all dry cleaning and laundry equipment is serviced annually by certified technicians, with maintenance records readily available for review. Additionally, we do not operate any self-service, unattended coin-operated laundries or industrial laundries that process hazardous or medical textiles. We also confirm that all cleaning solvents used are approved and compliant with environmental regulations.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Clothing alteration services operated alongside Crystal Clean Laundry Services.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, a water leak occurred due to a plumbing failure, causing damages to several machines and dry cleaning supplies totaling $2,500. Repairs have been made, and the situation is now resolved.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class III, Grade A, UL Listed
